note: To add a plugin, add one entry to "plugins". Downloads are only listed once a real file exists; status "coming_soon" entries have no downloads.

plugins.name: Twitch
plugins.author: Nocto
plugins.description: Sign in to Twitch from inside Nocto (no stream key typing, no browser redirect server), edit your stream title, category and tags, and read and send chat in a dock next to your preview.
features: Sign in with a device code (no password or stream key typed into Nocto)
Edit stream title, category and tags
Chat dock: read and send chat
plugins.install: In Nocto 0.8.0 or newer: File > Plugins... > Browse plugins... > Load plugin list > Install next to Twitch (or Install from .zip... with the zip for your system), then restart Nocto and open the Twitch dock to sign in. Nocto 0.7.3 and older: File > Plugins... > Open user plugins folder and copy the file from the zip into it.

plugins.name: Vignette (sample shader)
plugins.author: Nocto
plugins.description: Shader-only video filter: darkens the edges of a source. Strength, radius and tint. No compiler needed, and a good starting point for your own shader filters.
plugins.install: In Nocto 0.8.0 or newer: File > Plugins... > Install from .zip..., pick this zip, then restart Nocto. Older versions: File > Plugins... > Open user plugins folder, copy the files from the zip into it, then enable the plugin in the Plugins window.

tools.name: Nocto Plugin SDK
tools.description: Header, CMake template and samples for writing native plugins and shader filters, now with the ABI 2 API (panels, settings, secrets, HTTP/WebSocket, timers) and the full Twitch plugin source.
